description: Gets a league's games from today through the next few days, grouped by day in the league's day zone, with each game's score as the board shows it and its permalink key. Pass days=1 for today alone, or a team id for that club's games. Answers "what games are on today" and "who plays this week".

code.description: The league code, in any case.

days.description: How many days from today, today included: 1 for today alone, 7 for the week ahead.

team.description: A club of the league whose games alone the slate holds; null for every club's.

name: get_league_slate

build.description: The running build's id, so a page's tag turns over on deploy.

days.description: Each day of the window holding a game, in order, its games by start; a day with none isn't listed.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

outcome.description: How the game went for this side, as Outcome judges it; null until Final.

segments.description: The line score in the scoreboard's segment order; a null value is a segment not played.

order.description: Cricket: the innings' place in the match, 1 for the side that batted first; null in every other sport.

overs.description: Cricket: the overs the innings lasted, in overs-and-balls notation (19.4 is nineteen overs and four balls); null in every other sport.

value.description: The points scored, or null when the segment was not played; never zero for that.

wickets.description: Cricket: the wickets down in the innings; null in every other sport.

stats.description: The scoreboard's stats the provider reported, by key.

total.description: The provider's total, or null when no result carries one.

declared.description: How a final ended as the provider declared it, for a sport whose totals can't say (cricket): who won and by what, a tie, or no result. Null in every other sport and before the end.

margin.description: What the win was by, when the provider said; null on every other verdict, and on a win it gave no margin for.

innings.description: The winners batted once and still made more than the other side's two innings: "by an innings and 12 runs".

revised.description: The target was revised for lost time, by the Duckworth–Lewis–Stern method.

unit.description: Runs when the side batting first won, wickets when the side batting last did.

winner.description: The side that won; set on Won only.

locationTbd.description: The provider has named no ground for it yet, so its location is to be decided ("Location TBD") and Venue is null: not its home club's ground. A page writes no structured event for it, since an event's location is required.

position.description: Where a live game is; null in every other state.

break.description: The provider's pause between segments, which overrides the segment's reading on a board.

clock.description: The provider's timer text; always null when Source is Inferred.

half.description: Which half of the inning, on a scoreboard that PlaysHalves.

segment.description: The segment in play, in the scoreboard's keys; null when nothing places the game.

venue.description: The venue's name, where one is stored.

events.description: Each game of Days and Later as an event: its end, its first start when moved, its ground and its key.

endTime.description: When it ends, in UTC: the stored end, else the start plus the league's match length.

previousStartTime.description: The start it was first set for, in UTC, when it has since moved; null when it never has.

venue.description: Where it is played, where the league holds the ground; null otherwise.

country.description: The country, as the provider names it.

zone.description: The zone the stadium clock keeps (IANA): the venue's, else the league's day zone.

later.description: When Days is empty, what comes next, by start: the league's next game day, or the club's next games.

venue.description: The venue's name, where one is stored.

ingesting.description: Whether ingestion is switched on; a league switched off still answers, with scores that no longer move.

sport.description: The sport's code (SOCCER), which decides a screen's words: a soccer board shows matches, not games.

more.description: Whether the window holds more than Cap games, so Days stops short.

declares.description: Whether a final's result is declared rather than read from the totals (Declared); cricket only.

playsHalves.description: Whether a segment has a top and bottom half; baseball only.

countsToTotal.description: Whether the provider's total includes it.

key.description: The stored key, e.g. q1 or ot; unique within its scoreboard.

kind.description: Whether it is regulation, extra play or a decider.

label.description: The column heading a line score prints.
The column heading a line score prints, e.g. H.

team.description: The club the slate is for, or null for the league's.

today.description: The first day of the window: today in the league's day zone.

zone.description: The league's day zone (IANA), which the days are cut in and a page states start times in.

title: League games today or this week
